name: QuantX-Stock-Analysis-and-Forecast
description: An advanced stock analysis and forecasting platform.  QuantX provides real-time financial metrics, key technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI),  and sentiment-analyzed market news. It features a prediction engine  that runs and contrasts 8 models, ranging from classical time-series to machine learning.

paragraphs: An elegant, high-fidelity AI-powered dashboard to analyze stock trends, compute technical indicators, and forecast stock prices using optimized Machine Learning.
Real-time market analytics, automated sentiment scoring, and multi-model financial forecasting driven by Python and Streamlit.

QuantX is an open-source financial analytics and machine learning forecasting tool. Built with modern modular Python and managed via the Rust-based uv package manager, QuantX provides real-time market overviews for global indices and individual stocks (including Indian NSE stocks with .NS suffixes).
features: Feature Construction: Constructs temporal feature matrices containing day indexes, day of the week, and month numbers.
Standardization: Features are scaled using StandardScaler to ensure optimal convergence for regression models.
Train-Test Partitioning: Partitions 90% training data and 10% sequential test evaluation data without data leakage (shuffle=False).
RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error): Penalizes larger prediction variance.
MAE (Mean Absolute Error): Average absolute deviation from ground-truth price.
